_notes: THE STARTUP CHARGE -- see prismatic_orb_water_charge.json's notes for the
CHARGE_HANDOFF.md for the brief, which calls this element out by name for
halo softness. Same six-cell, no-compose layout; wind_charge_6f.png is
DELIVERED WITH ITS OWN ALPHA; keyed is false.
THE HANDOFF'S WARNING IS MEASURED, NOT JUST OBSERVED. This is the softest
sheet of the four: every one of the six cells has partial-alpha coverage
at or above 91% of its drawn area (water/fire/earth run 50-100% and drop
as low as 50% on the densest frames; here the crescent NEVER reaches a
hard core). The drawn bounds are also the widest of the pack -- 49-57% of
the 512 canvas versus 30-47% for the other three -- because the wisp has
no dense centre to anchor a tight bbox around. Both readings point the
same way: this sheet reads as haze rather than a crisp glyph at the sizes
SIZED SMALLEST OF THE FOUR IN skills.json FOR EXACTLY THAT REASON -- see
that file's comment for the arithmetic. Shrinking the box tightens the
glow along with the shape; there is no crop that fixes soft alpha without
re-painting the source, so this recipe does not attempt one.
